    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->

+"""RoboLab rcb-limited/2.2 episode controller for animals_in_bin.

+import os, sys, json
+import numpy as np

+for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+    Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/episode/initial_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)

+    np.save(f"/app/output/episode/initial_{cam}_depth.npy", d)
+now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+q0 = now[:7].copy()
+tcp0 = now[8:15].copy()  # x y z qw qx qy qz

+print("connected", r.base, "time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+print("initial_tcp", tcp0.tolist())
+
+_action_count = 0
+def move(x, y, z, grip=0, note=""):
+    """Move fingertip-centre TCP; grip 0 opens and 1 closes."""
+    global _action_count
+    target = np.array([[x, y, z, *down, grip]], dtype=np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", target, video="frames", video_fps=10,
+                   note=note or f"ee to {x:.3f},{y:.3f},{z:.3f}; gripper {grip}")
+    _action_count += 1
+    os.makedirs("/app/output/episode", exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():

+    print("move", _action_count, "target", target[0].tolist(), "done", res.done,
+          "reason", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"),
+          "tcp", res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15])
+    return res
+
+def observe(seconds=0):
+    res = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, depth=True, video="frames")

+          "done", res.done, "reason", res.meta.get("reason"))
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/episode/obs_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    for cam, d in res.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(f"/app/output/episode/obs_{cam}_depth.npy", d)
+    return res
+
+def pick_and_place(x, y, bin_x, bin_y, place_z=0.012, name="lizard"):
+    """Top-down parallel-jaw pick, lift over the bin, release inside it."""
+    # Hover, descend with jaws already open, close gently around the torso.
+    move(x, y, 0.20, 0, f"{name}: hover")
+    move(x, y, 0.010, 0, f"{name}: descend to grasp")
+    move(x, y, 0.010, 1, f"{name}: close on torso")
+    move(x, y, 0.22, 1, f"{name}: lift")
+    # Cross the rim while high, then lower the held object's centre inside.

+    move(bin_x, bin_y, place_z, 1, f"{name}: lower into bin")
